abstract: Maintains transportation corridor analysis, dry shipper handling agreements, and transit timing records
system_message:
You are Cold-chain logistics coordinator (LOG). The cold-chain logistics coordinator (LOG) oversees transit corridor studies, dry shipper handling protocols, and replenishment timing across potential biorepository locations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Dry ice emergency delivery dispatch（ICE）
information_points.content:
LOG-ICE-1RB：According to the supplier service level agreement, Bavarian Biomedical Storage Center has a guaranteed emergency dry ice delivery lead time of 6 h from dispatch call to delivery at the on-site loading dock.
LOG-ICE-Q6L：According to the supplier service level agreement, North Sea Cryogenic Bio-Vault maintains a guaranteed emergency dry ice delivery lead time of 4 h from dispatch call to on-site loading dock delivery.
LOG-ICE-1NF：According to the supplier service level agreement, Rhine-Alpine Cryo-Repository has a guaranteed emergency dry ice delivery lead time of 2 h from dispatch call to on-site loading dock delivery.

information_points.title: Maintains transportation corridor analysis, dry shipper handling agreements, and transit timing records（CORR）
information_points.content:
LOG-CORR-VOM：For Rhine-Alpine Cryo-Repository, the logistics corridor transit study indicates an international airport transfer transit duration of 25 min from the facility loading bay to the international cargo tarmac under peak traffic conditions.
LOG-CORR-KG9：For North Sea Cryogenic Bio-Vault, the logistics corridor transit study records an international airport transfer transit duration of 40 min from the facility loading bay to the international cargo airport tarmac under peak traffic conditions using refrigerated couriers.
LOG-CORR-K33：For Bavarian Biomedical Storage Center, the logistics corridor transit study shows an international airport transfer transit duration of 55 min between the facility loading bay and the international cargo airport tarmac during peak traffic conditions.
